title: Religious leaders, lawmakers push for $1 billion to secure houses of worship
summary: There's an effort on Capitol Hill to increase funding for the Nonprofit Security Grant Program, which awards funding to houses of worship to harden their defenses. In 2024, roughly a third of those who applied actually received funding.
